verdict.rationale: SumUp is an API-driven payments platform, so API versioning and deprecation policy is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions API versions, version pinning, changelogs, or a deprecation or sunset policy. The SDK, MCP server and webhook docs describe other capabilities and do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
